acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira talks to two members of a recreational swimming club who intentionally swam straight toward a shark that had just bitten their friend.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Sarah Polley has always been reluctant to jump into challenging situations. Then something happened that changed all of that – something that also made her think her teeth were going to fall out.
acts.title: If I Only Had My Brain

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Comedian Josh Johnson tells the story of a “trad wife” who stepped into an incendiary situation. And even as the flames consumed her, she kept stepping.
acts.title: Am I Doing It Alt-Right, You Guys?

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: This summer, thousands of young people have taken to the streets in Nairobi to protest the Kenyan government. But behind those protestors are thousands of worried parents. Reporter Kimu Elolia talks to a woman whose son keeps lying to her.
acts.credits: By Kimu Elolia; Produced by Emmanuel Dzotsi; Additional reporting by Henry Larson
acts.title: Mom Thinks He Doth Protest Too Much
